sec: sec:C011: Third-party testing for out-of-scope outputs

blocks.id: blk:C011: Third-party testing for out-of-scope outputs/1
blocks.text: Appoint expert third parties to evaluate system robustness to out-of-scope outputs at least every 3 months (e.g. political discussion, healthcare advice).
